fato_historico: 1988: Lancang–Gengma earthquakes: At least 730 are killed after two powerful earthquakes rock the China–Myanmar border in Yunnan Province.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a grounding energy that encourages you to reflect on resilience. Just as the earth shifts, we are reminded of the fragility of our foundations. It is a good time to nurture your inner stability, build bridges of empathy with those around you, and appreciate the steady growth you are cultivating in your personal journey.
frase_do_dia: Even when the earth trembles, your roots run deep and strong.
significado_numero: A number representing spiritual wisdom and deep inner contemplation.
conselho: Consider reaching out to a friend to share warmth and quiet support today.
